data.title: AI Mom Can Remember Everything. But Can She Really Be A Mother?
data.description: With her solo show “Womb Wetware,” artist Jiabao Li explores the invisible scars and emotional labor of motherhood — and the forces that seek to regulate the female body.
data.author: Leslie Katz
